text: This zoning by-law amendment application proposes the development of the subject lands with six commercial-retail buildings, including 2 drive-through facilities; a fuel station and a vehicle washing establishment at 2130 Morningside Avenue. The application also proposes to expand the list of permitted uses on the subject lands to permit all uses under the Commercial Local (CL) Zone in the City of Toronto Zoning By-law 569-2013, as well as a drive-through facility (2) and a vehicle washing establishment. A total gross floor area of 3 220 square metres is being proposed along with 145 surface parking spaces. This report provides preliminary information on the above-noted application and seeks Community Council's directions on further processing of the application and on the community consultation process. Scarborough Community Council: 1. Directed City Planning staff to schedule a community consultation meeting for the lands at 2130 Morningside Avenue together with the Ward Councillor. 2. Directed City Planning staff to give Notice for the community consultation meeting to landowners and residents within 120 metres of the site, and the area as identified on the notification area map attached to the motion, and further, that the additional costs for Notice beyond the 120 metres from the subject site be borne by the Applicant. 3. Directed City Clerk's staff to give Notice for the public meeting under the Planning Act according to the regulations of the Planning Act.
